scope: Small discovery slice; free software is not proof of installed access or total project cost.

ffmpeg.basis: free software; build and use rights require review

blender.basis: free software; installed version and asset rights require review

kokoro.basis: Local ONNX wrapper and model; specific voice and source rights require review.
kokoro.evidence_basis: retained licence notes, not a fresh upstream or installation check

mlx-audio.basis: Local runtime; only retained Kokoro model scope, other model terms not inferred.
mlx-audio.evidence_basis: retained licence notes, not a fresh upstream or installation check

supertonic3.basis: Local SDK and stock weights; model use restrictions and synthetic-content disclosure remain.
supertonic3.evidence_basis: retained licence notes, not a fresh upstream or installation check

piper.basis: Local synthesis; engine and individual voice licences differ; default weak-voice fallback excluded.
piper.evidence_basis: retained licence notes, not a fresh upstream or installation check

hyperframes.basis: Local CLI runtime; optional cloud or AI assets and external services not included.
hyperframes.evidence_basis: retained licence notes, not a fresh upstream or installation check

remotion.basis: Free/Company eligibility and paid features depend on user and operation; quote or eligibility check needed.
